messages:
Ellen (Design): Quick design check 11 on the Data Retention card in Settings. Two small but recurring asks from research: (1) preset labels feel ambiguous (e.g., 'Short') and (2) exported audit CSV column headers read like internal keys. Can we make both more explicit?

Max (Frontend): Paste current labels? I think they are: Short, Standard, Long, Custom. CSV headers are: evt_ts, evt_type, usr, details.

Jose (PM): Users said 'Short' makes them worry it's deleting critical logs sooner than expected. Suggest numeric-first labels: "7 days", "30 days (default)", "90 days", "Custom" — so it's explicit.

Priya (Docs): Strong +1 to numeric labels. Also recommend adding a micro-copy line under presets: "Applies to API events, audit logs, and exports" so people know scope.

Omar (a11y): Accessibility note: when we render "30 days (default)" visually, screen readers should get "30 days, default" not "30 days open paren default close paren". Use aria-label="30 days, default". Also ensure focus order keeps presets in logical sequence.

Leah (Security): For CSV exports: current header evt_type is too technical. SOCs expect human-friendly headers for quick triage. Proposed mapping: evt_ts -> Event time (ISO8601), evt_type -> Event type, usr -> Actor, details -> Details, key_owner -> Key owner (when present). We should keep raw fields in a machine column (raw_payload) for power users.

Ellen (Design): Draft microcopy for the card: Header: "Retention period" Subtext: "How long generated data (logs, audit events, and exports) is retained." Presets shown as numeric chips: "7 days", "30 days (default)", "90 days", "Custom...". Export CTA: "Export logs" with accessible name "Export logs as CSV".

Max (Frontend): I'll implement the chips & aria-label change. For CSV header remapping, quick question: do we rename headers in the exported file or add a human_headers row? Changing header names could break automations.

Leah (Security): Good call. Please include both: keep machine headers (evt_ts, evt_type, usr, details) and add a first optional row called "human_headers" that maps them e.g., "human_headers: Event time (ISO8601), Event type, Actor, Details". That way parsers stay intact and humans get clarity.

Jose (PM): That sounds ideal. Also mention retention scope in Export modal: "This export contains events within the selected retention window."

Priya (Docs): I'll add a short section in docs and an example CSV snippet: 
```
# human_headers: Event time (ISO8601), Event type, Actor, Details
evt_ts,evt_type,usr,details
2025-03-10T15:22:01Z,kms.key.rotate,alice@example.com,"Key rotated, key_id=abc123"
```
I'll also document the "human_headers" convention and recommend parsing logic.

Omar (a11y): For the Export modal ensure the download button is reachable with keyboard and that the file name is descriptive: `redwood-audit-export-YYYYMMDD.csv`. Also announce completion with an aria-live message: "Export ready: redwood-audit-export-20250310.csv".

Max (Frontend): Sounds good. I'll add non-breaking spaces to keep "30 days" with the default tag together when space constrained. For the CSV change I'll add the human_headers row only when users opt into "Include human headers" in the modal (default ON).

notify-bot: Note: Changing CSV layout is a breaking change for some customers. Created ticket DATAEXPORT-211 and flagged customer success.

Leah (Security): Also add column key_owner in exports when present, and include a footnote in the modal: "Fields containing key identifiers do not include key material."

Ellen (Design): To summarize final strings I'll put in Figma and the ticket: header "Retention period"; subtext "How long generated data (logs, audit events, and exports) is retained." Presets: "7 days", "30 days (default)", "90 days", "Custom..." Export modal: default ON toggle "Include human headers". CSV sample as Priya posted.

Jose (PM): Action items: Ellen - finalize Figma copy; Max - frontend PR for chips & Export modal + CSV human_headers opt-in; Priya - docs snippet; Omar - a11y QA; Leah - confirm security footnote. Deadline: next Wednesday.

Ellen (Design): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the ticket and ping CS about DATAEXPORT-211. Closing thread once PR & DOCS links are attached.
